values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day campsite reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 7 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Sites are not numbered consecutively; an extension cord may be needed to reach the power post.

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica, 2027 season May 14-Oct 11 (2026: May 15-Oct 11). Added 9-month window, same-day/walk-ins, 2-night minimum waived within 7 days, 14-night max, 50 A (on 18 sites; 50 of 77 have electric), 77 sites to 40 ft (back-in), showers, dump, laundry, camp store, water fill. ReserveAmerica tags AWH's sites 35, 37 and 41 'Near Water' (only 4 sites carry the tag). Fees left as read 2026-10-12. AWH note kept.
